lines: Baker, Isaiah 55 is the LORD throwing the doors wide open and calling, COME. Thirsty? Come. No money? Come anyway. What He offers is free (Isa 55:1).
Meanwhile people keep spending money and work on what doesn't satisfy (Isa 55:2). That's paying for a gym membership every month and only ever using the parking lot.
The real feast is listening to Him: "listen, so that your soul may live," the LORD says, and He backs it with an everlasting covenant, His loving devotion promised to David (Isa 55:3).
Then the call goes out: "Seek the LORD while He may be found." Anyone who turns back, even the wicked man, our God will freely pardon (Isa 55:6-7). FREELY. Same price tag as the water!
Sound too good to be true? That's because His thoughts and ways are higher than ours, as high as the heavens over the earth (Isa 55:8-9).
And His word never comes back empty. Like rain and snow, it does what He sends it to do (Isa 55:10-11). Friend, I send one message to a group chat and get back... NOTHING. His word? Never.
It ends in joy and peace, with singing mountains, clapping trees and cypress where the thornbush was, a name for the LORD that lasts forever (Isa 55:12-13). So come thirsty, come broke, just COME.
